entries.entry_name: Tracking Ice Tornado — Kjarg the Tuskscraper
entries.mitigation: Marked player kites the slow tornado away from the group and stays out of Kjarg's frontal lane.
Kill Frost Atronachs before they settle into stationary ranged pressure and start filling the group with ice bolts.
Tank kites Kjarg while he is enraged and keeps the hammer-cone direction away from the group.
Marked player separates from teammates and brings the fire circle to frozen Stranglers to remove their protection, then the group kills them.
Heal through the tank drain and do not cleanse the effect, because cleansing adds extra damage.

entries.entry_name: Draining Skeleton Tethers — Vearogh the Shambler
entries.mitigation: Kill tethering skeletons promptly so their blue-beam drain does not remain on players.
Focus Wraiths quickly before they keep summoning more skeletons and turn add pressure into a snowball.
Kill edge-spawned Storm Atronachs quickly before they empower the boss.
Group tightly enough for efficient healing during the arena-wide storm while continuing to avoid local ground effects.
Tank keeps the currently vulnerable enraged sister taunted at all times while the group resolves her associated add mechanic before pushing onward.
Interrupt all four sisters immediately during the shared channel. Treat a missed interrupt as a wipe condition, not recoverable background damage.
Regroup for concentrated healing and burn Ciannait before escalating pulse damage overwhelms the group, while still respecting lingering arena mechanics.
Destroy the totem immediately before its repeated magical bolts ramp into group-wide lethal pressure.
Kill each Flesh Abomination as it appears instead of over-burning Hakgrym and allowing multiple slam adds to overlap.

entries.entry_name: Kiln Rune Identification — Keeper of the Kiln
entries.mitigation: Assigned players grapple up, identify the correct symbol, and activate it so the tank can move the Keeper to the matching ground rune.

entries.entry_name: Boss Shield Break — Keeper of the Kiln
entries.mitigation: Once the correct rune is revealed, place the Keeper on it and break the boss shield before the room-wide fire finishes its lethal cycle.
Stand in the safe center of the spin or fully outside it; avoid sitting in overlapping rings from the boss and reflections.
Control or kill reflections during their spawn cycles so simultaneous spin pressure does not overwhelm positioning and healing.
Tank grabs the Bone Colossus immediately and the group prioritizes it before another add cycle or phase transition overlaps.

entries.entry_name: Toxic Gas Escape — Ondagore the Mad
entries.mitigation: When the center fills with toxic gas, grapple to the outer platforms, kill the required ghosts, and return only after the gas clears.
Kill the four menders while using the glowing safe positions behind pillars to survive Ondagore's lethal pulse explosions.
Block or move out of the fast magic waves and keep healing ready for anyone clipped by the burst.
Prioritize the two-hander and Blastbones before they reach empowering runes; crowd control the two-hander when useful.
For the Hard Mode challenge, destroy the Skull Totem, then immediately resume normal priority handling rather than losing control of skeleton and ground pressure.
